description:
Local plan site allocations, broad locations, land availability
    assessment (SHLAA/HELAA/LAA) sites and call-for-sites submissions, in an
    authority or near a site (`radius_m`, up to 10 km). Each site carries the
    council's own reference, units and area AS PUBLISHED beside our
    calculated area, its status and the council's wording for it, the plan and
    stage, the delivery timescale, notes, and provenance with the source page.
    `laa_positive` is the council's "suitable, available, achievable" view.

    COVERAGE: built from council and GLA GIS layers and plan documents,
    authority by authority. Where we hold nothing for an authority the answer
    says coverage `none`, which is NOT "no sites". The council's figures beat
    ours. Give exactly ONE scope: `location` ("lat,lng"), `postcode`,
    `area_geojson` (a red line, GeoJSON in WGS84, at most 150 km² and 64
    vertices), `land_id` or `lpa_code` (GSS, e.g. E07000240); anything else is
    refused before any read and nothing is charged. UK only. Free.
name: strategic_sites
title: Allocations and land availability sites
